observed.finding: The Payments page receivables panel is OVERDUE-only by design (Payments.tsx: a receivable row appears when booking.to <= now and the posted balance is short). The fixture return date (2026-11-23) is in the future, so the contract correctly does NOT appear as an overdue receivable; the fixture PAYMENT row itself was present in the DOM (car name + 120 figure both found in 4c). The amount-due figure (180) is proven by 4b using the page’s own formula (rentalTotal - posted rent) and by the completion receivable in 3e (outstanding 300 before payment).
observed.semanticNote: contractReceivable marks a completed contract with a balance as overdue immediately at completion (dueAt = completion time), while the Payments page marks overdue only once the rental end has passed. The outstanding AMOUNT agrees everywhere (300 -> 180 after the 120 payment); only the overdue flag timing differs, each side documented in its own code. Recorded as a definition note, not a defect.

defects.title: Completed/cancelled contract lifecycle still reserves the car (availability never released)
defects.severity: functional coherence defect (step 5c FAIL before fix)
defects.rootCause: Availability logic keyed only on BookingStatus. bookingReservationHelper.saveBookingsWithAvailability conflict query (backend/src/utils/bookingReservationHelper.ts) and both frontend overlap lookups (backend/src/controllers/carController.ts getFrontendCars; backend/src/controllers/supplierController.ts getFrontendSuppliers) matched reserving statuses (deposit/paid/paidInFull/reserved, live void) without excluding terminal ContractLifecycle values. A booking that completed its lifecycle kept status reserved, so its car stayed unbookable for its window indefinitely (search excluded it; create-booking answered 400 BookingConflictError).
defects.fix: Minimal, pattern-following: exclude lifecycle completed/cancelled in all three places (mongoose lifecycle $nin in the helper; $not $in $lifecycle guard wrapping the status $or in both aggregations). Backend build PASS (185 files); the 3 compiled files were copied into the running backend container (docker cp, compose build is credential-blocked) and the container restarted; API healthy 200 after restart.
defects.rewalk: 5c-fix PASS (same window bookable again; probe created 200 and deleted) and 3b-fix PASS (a live reserved booking still blocks overlap; window frees after delete).
defects.lintNote: Backend lint has 16 pre-existing errors in untouched files (e.g. utils/helper.ts curly); the 3 touched files introduce no new lint problems (carController EOF blank-lines error and 2 unused-var warnings are identical at HEAD).
defects.tests: P0 gate 8 suites / 41 tests PASS (P0_EXIT=0); downtimeAvailability 9/9 PASS; backend build PASS (185 files).
